text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's approval rating today is 
overwhelming! Seen as the star of the 
show, she is surrounded by reporters for 
an interview.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka barges in! She passionately declares 
that victory today belongs to her, firing 
up both the press and the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the truth was that Vodka was 
terrified. Daiwa Scarlet, who had come to 
cheer her on, spurred her forward, saying 
the stage was set perfectly for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan watches the two close 
friends. But she silently fires herself 
up, refusing to let them take the win!
